verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated first-party webhooks page saying webhooks let you react to process events, sandbox lifecycle changes, and file modifications, which covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. The evidence is a single summary line, though, with no detail on how subscriptions work. Missing for 10: documented registration/subscription mechanics (API/SDK endpoints), payload schema, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
